title: Keeper of the Hyenas: A Night in Harar — የጅቦቹ ጠባቂ፡ አንድ ምሽት በሐረር
style_block: Authentic ungraded low-light 35mm documentary photograph outside the weathered dark grey stone fortress walls and arched gate of Harar Jugol at night, natural charcoal-black night sky without cyan or teal color cast, realistic warm kerosene lantern illumination only on nearby subjects, natural weathered human skin texture and realistic fabric creases, centered safe framing, no embedded text.

character_ref.prompt: Fictional seasoned Ethiopian Harari elder Umar (dark brown East African skin, short grey beard, patterned white turban, olive-brown embroidered tunic robe, colorful striped woven shoulder shawl, white cotton wrap) beside a woven straw basket of meat and glowing brass kerosene lantern, standing opposite fictional Ethiopian teenage boy Dawit (dark brown East African skin, short curly black hair, dark quilted zip jacket) outside Harar Jugol's arched coral-stone fortress gate at night under mist and moonlight, 35mm documentary realism.

music.caption: Atmospheric nocturnal Ethiopian acoustic score, deep resonant krar bass plucks, subtle traditional Harari percussive pulse, and haunting washint flute notes, building from quiet night tension to grounded reverence and peace, spacious under Amharic narration, no vocals

shots.shot_reason: Establish the nocturnal setting outside Harar Jugol's ancient walls, elder keeper Umar's calm authority, and Dawit's initial tension as glowing eyes appear in the dark. Locks blocking: Umar left, Dawit right, lantern and basket between them.
shots.visual_prompt: Wide centered nocturnal shot just outside the ancient weathered coral-stone wall and arched gate of Harar Jugol, seasoned Harari elder keeper Umar in traditional embroidered tunic and wrapped cotton headcloth standing calmly on the left beside a glowing amber lantern and woven straw basket, young man Dawit in a dark jacket standing slightly tense on the right, faint pairs of glowing hyena eyes visible in the moonlit brush beyond, key subjects inside the central safe frame.
shots.camera_motion: Gentle slow push-in toward the lantern-lit pair as night mist drifts softly.
shots.narration_text: የሐረር ጀጎል ጥንታዊ ግንብ ሲጨልም፣ የሌሊቱ ጸጥታ በጅቦቹ ድምፅ ይሰበራል።
shots.subtitle_en:
As dusk dims Harar Jugol's walls,
the night breaks with hyena calls.
shots.music_cue: Low resonant krar drone and distant night wind enter under dark atmosphere.

shots.shot_reason: Show the traditional woven straw basket of meat scraps and the short wooden feeding stick, grounding the ritual in real Harari practice rather than spectacle.
shots.visual_prompt: Tight overhead close-up insert of weathered Ethiopian elder hands preparing pieces of raw meat on a smooth short wooden stick beside an open woven straw basket and a glowing brass oil lantern resting on dusty stone ground outside Harar Jugol at night, warm amber light, shallow depth of field, no faces visible.
shots.camera_motion: Slow steady push-in over the keeper's steady hands and woven basket.
shots.narration_text: ለዘመናት በዘለቀው የሐረር ወግ፣ ፍርሃት በመተማመን ይተካል።
shots.subtitle_en:
In this old Harari tradition,
fear slowly yields to trust.
shots.music_cue: Subtle hand-drum pulse enters quietly beneath the lantern glow.

shots.shot_reason: Deliver the keeper's central heritage wisdom on mutual peace and respect between Harar's people and the hyenas.
shots.visual_prompt: Single-person centered close-up portrait of seasoned Ethiopian Harari elder Umar (dark brown East African skin, short grey beard, white wrapped turban, beige embroidered Harari tunic) bathed in warm golden lantern light against rough coral-stone Harar wall at night, looking calmly off toward the right shadows as he calls softly, no second person in frame.
shots.camera_motion: Very slow gentle push-in on Umar's serene, focused face.
shots.narration_text: እርሱም፣ ጠባቂውም፣ በስማቸው እየጠራ፣ ሰላምን ስትሰጥ ሰላምን ታገኛለህ፣ ተፈጥሮ ክብርን ታውቃለች አለኝ።
shots.subtitle_en:
Calling them softly, the keeper said:
'Give peace, and nature knows respect.'
shots.music_cue: Soft haunting washint flute phrase answers gently.

shots.shot_reason: Show the peaceful feeding interaction—the hyena approaching calmly in lantern light without aggression, proving the keeper's words.
shots.visual_prompt: Unretouched low-light 35mm documentary photograph matching the exact natural dark slate sky, weathered grey-brown Harar stone fortress gate, subtle mist, woven straw basket of meat, brass kerosene lantern on the ground, and realistic African spotted hyena of the reference image — no teal/cyan cast and no moon. Remove the boy completely so only elder keeper Umar and the spotted hyena are present: elder Ethiopian Harari man Umar (clear natural three-quarter face softly lit from below by the lantern, realistic weathered skin, short grey beard, patterned white turban, olive-brown embroidered tunic, colorful striped Ethiopian woven shawl, white wrap) standing with relaxed natural posture and bent elbow, leaning gently forward as he extends the short wooden feeding stick with meat calmly toward the spotted hyena.
shots.camera_motion: Locked-off camera holding cleanly on the calm, respectful exchange.
shots.narration_text: ጅቦቹም በተራቸው ቀርበው ሲበሉ፣ የዱር አውሬ ሳይሆን የከተማዋ ጎረቤቶች ይመስላሉ።
shots.subtitle_en:
Stepping in calmly to feed, they feel
less like beasts than city neighbors.
shots.music_cue: Plucked krar melody carries steady, grounded calm.

shots.shot_reason: Mark Dawit's internal turning point: letting go of fear, stepping forward, and holding the wooden feeding stick.
shots.visual_prompt: Medium nocturnal shot outside Harar Jugol's arched stone fortress gate in warm kerosene lantern light: Ethiopian teenage boy Dawit (dark brown skin, short curly black hair, dark quilted zip jacket) stepping bravely forward while firmly holding the short wooden feeding stick with a small piece of raw meat above the woven straw basket and glowing lantern.
shots.camera_motion: Slow steady push-in as Dawit's expression shifts from hesitation to quiet courage.
shots.narration_text: ልቤ ቢመታም ፍርሃቴን ተውኩት፤ በትዕግሥት ወደፊት ተራመድኩ።
shots.subtitle_en:
Though my heart raced, I left fear
behind and stepped forward patiently.
shots.music_cue: Harmonic shift softens from minor tension into warm resonance.

shots.shot_reason: Hold a wordless emotional pause showing elder Umar's quiet nod of approval and trust.
shots.visual_prompt: Unretouched low-light 35mm documentary close-up photograph keeping the exact realistic weathered dark brown skin texture, eyes, short grey beard, patterned white turban, olive-brown embroidered tunic, and blurred dark grey Harar stone battlements from the reference image — neutral dark slate night tones with zero cyan haze and no visible lantern in frame; frame slightly closer from chest up with elder Umar looking slightly left/forward in a calm, composed, natural relaxed expression of quiet trust and warmth (no exaggerated grin).
shots.camera_motion: Locked-off camera, subtle nod and flickering lantern light.
shots.music_cue: No narration; warm krar and washint melody swells gently in the silence.

shots.shot_reason: Demonstrate Dawit's transformation in action: calmly offering food to a hyena under Umar's steady presence.
shots.visual_prompt: Medium nocturnal shot outside Harar Jugol's stone gate in warm kerosene lantern light: Ethiopian teenage boy Dawit standing beside elder Umar (patterned white turban, olive embroidered robe, colorful striped shawl), Dawit extending the short wooden feeding stick with meat steadily toward a calm African spotted hyena facing them beside the woven basket and glowing lantern.
shots.camera_motion: Gentle slow side drift keeping Dawit, Umar, and the hyena inside the central safe frame.
shots.narration_text: በእርጋታ ስቀርብ፣ ሌሊቱ አስፈሪ መሆኑ ቀርቶ የአብሮነት ምስክር ሆነ።
shots.subtitle_en:
When I came in stillness, the dark
became a witness to coexistence.
shots.music_cue: Main acoustic theme lifts warmly as trust is shared.

shots.shot_reason: Resolve the film by mirroring Shot 01's wide composition outside Harar Jugol's walls in peaceful harmony as hyenas retreat into the moonlit night.
shots.visual_prompt: Distant wide-angle cinematic shot outside the ancient coral-stone wall and arched gate of Harar Jugol under a deep indigo starry sky and bright moon: Ethiopian elder Umar (dark brown East African skin, white wrapped turban, embroidered beige tunic) on the left and Ethiopian teenage boy Dawit (warm dark brown East African skin, short curly black hair, dark hooded jacket) on the right standing smaller in the frame beside a warm glowing lantern and woven basket, two African spotted hyenas (Crocuta crocuta with rounded ears, sloping backs, spotted tan coats) walking peacefully away down the moonlit dirt path into distant hills.
shots.camera_motion: Slow gentle pull-back revealing the ancient silhouette of Harar Jugol under moonlight.
shots.narration_text: የሐረር ጥበብ ይህ ነው፤ ሰውና ተፈጥሮ በክብር ሲተያዩ፣ ጨለማው እንኳ ሰላምን ያውጃል።
shots.subtitle_en:
This is Harar's wisdom: when people
and nature meet in respect, peace wins.
shots.music_cue: Final resonant krar chord rings warmly and fades cleanly into night ambiance.
